title: Context-Aware Counterfactual Data Augmentation for Gender Bias Mitigation in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using intrinsic bias benchmarks (StereoSet, CrowS-Pairs) to measure stereotypical associations, extrinsic bias benchmarks (BiasBios, STS-B, NLI-Bias) to measure prediction accuracy and performance disparities between male and female groups, and analysis of next-token generation probability distributions for gender-related words.
